content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the \"cap / floor:screen\" Save action, a validation error becomes visible shortly after each Save click, and the events show the user editing Notional and Counterparty between attempts without any error-cleared event, so the same error seems to persist across the three Save attempts; the Counterparty error is already visible on focus before the first Save, which suggests the error is not tied to the field being edited.", "fix": "Fix: On the \"cap / floor:screen\" form, render the validation message inline beside the specific invalid input (Notional and Counterparty) instead of a generic error after the Save button, and clear that message when the input changes, so the Save button's error state reflects the current field values.", "cited_event_ids": ["277:a298", "295", "282", "283", "335", "336", "358", "app:36", "app:43", "app:50", "405"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["Error message text and the field(s) it refers to are not present in the events", "Whether the error clears or re-validates on field edits is not logged; only visible-error events appear", "Which field fails Save validation is not verifiable", "Only one session is covered; no coverage gaps were reported", "Time lost and severity are taken from the insight facts, not verified from events"]}
